what: scripts/ops/desk_near_signals.py has no unit rule for e4_oi_shock_1h, so the desk scan packet reads the leg `unlooked` (loud, pinned in tests/test_desk_near_signals.py). Its trigger is an open-interest z-score, not a candle pattern, so a near-signal probe needs the live OI store (src/runtime/oi_feed.py, runtime_logs/oi_feed/<SYM>.json) in the packet: probe = latest 1h OI-change z vs the 3.0 threshold. Same known-gap family as fade_breakout_4h / fvg_range_15m / squeeze_breakout_4h / turtle_soup.
